_why: UX6's tasks (docs/2026-10-04-ux6-redesign.md §9.4), the fifth measure of §9.1: the presses from the screen a person starts on to the act done, and the rows they scan to find it. Declared here and not measured (UX6a): a task crosses screens, so its presses are counted on the window by following its route, which no story renders whole. `node tools/ux-count.mjs --tasks` prints them. `before` and `after` are the design's words. `measured` is null until a person counts one on the install, then `{ "presses": n, "scanned": n, "on": "<date> <what was counted on>" }`.

tasks.task: Publish an ask its declarations proposed
tasks.before: 2 presses (the row's door, then the ask's Publish)

tasks.task: Sign in an account a waiting start needs
tasks.before: not said anywhere; then Settings, Agents, find it, Sign in: 3 presses and a scroll

tasks.task: See everything set for one repository

tasks.before: Settings → Workspace, scan 31 rows, 3 controls and Save
tasks.after: Repositories → it (filtered) → Setup → Work, 3 controls and Save; no row scanned

tasks.task: See which accounts a workspace may run on, and their state
tasks.before: Settings → Agents, under each workspace, per agent
tasks.after: Agents → the agent → Workspaces, or the workspace's Details

tasks.task: Install the tool a plugin needs
tasks.before: the plugin's prose, then Settings → Tools, find it, Managed
tasks.after: the plugin's page → its tool → Managed
